# UiForm

A `<form>` bound to a Formisch store that awaits a typed submit callback.

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| Category | forms |
| Import | `import { UiForm } from '@your-scope/ui/forms'` |
| Direct import | `import UiForm from '@your-scope/ui/components/UiForm'` |
| Source | [`packages/ui/src/forms/UiForm.vue`](../../packages/ui/src/forms/UiForm.vue) |
| Generic | `TSchema extends FormSchema` |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `of` **(required)** | `FormStore<TFormSchema>` |  | The Formisch store returned by `useForm()`. |
| `submit` **(required)** | `SubmitEventHandler<TFormSchema>` |  | Called with the validated output when the form is submitted and valid. It is **awaited**: the form stays in its submitting state (and further submissions are ignored) until the returned promise settles. A rejection becomes a form-level error. |

## Events

| Event | Payload | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `submitted` | `[]` | The `submit` callback resolved. Notification only: it is not awaited. |
| `invalid` | `[]` | Validation failed on submit. |
| `error` | `[error: unknown]` | The `submit` callback rejected. |

## Slots

| Slot | Slot props | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `default` | `props: { isSubmitting: boolean; isValid: boolean; isDirty: boolean }` |  |

## Exposed

Available on a template ref of the component.

| Member | Kind | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `requestSubmit` | method | Submit through the native form (fires `submit`, runs validation and the duplicate guard). Never `form.submit()`, which would bypass all of that. |
| `reset` | method | Reset the Formisch store to its initial input. |
| `element` | property | The native form element. |

## Attributes

The native `<form>`.

## Keyboard

- Enter in a field submits (native implicit submission).

## Accessibility

- `novalidate`: validation and messages come from the schema, shown next to each field.
- After a failed submission focus moves to the first invalid field.
- `aria-busy` while submitting; further submissions (button, Enter, `requestSubmit()`) are ignored until it settles.

## Styling

- `.vui-form`

## Example

From the gallery ([`apps/gallery/src/demos/FormsDemos.vue`](../../apps/gallery/src/demos/FormsDemos.vue)), where it is type-checked and covered by the end-to-end tests. `t()` is the gallery's translation function; the state it binds is declared in that file.

```vue
<UiForm :of="form" :submit="save" class="grid max-w-sm gap-3" data-testid="demo-form">
  <template #default="{ isSubmitting }">
    <UiFormErrorSummary />
    <UiInput v-bind="email.props" type="email" autocomplete="email" :label="t('demo.email')" required />
    <UiButton type="submit" class="justify-self-start" :loading="isSubmitting">{{
      t('actions.submit')
    }}</UiButton>
  </template>
</UiForm>
```
